subject: Calls fail with 401 after about an hour
body: Our reporting job starts at 02:00 UTC and works for a while, then every request to GET /v1/customers returns 401 with error.code token_expired. We request a token at the start of the job only. What is the right fix?
allowed_facts: access tokens expire 60 minutes after issue
refresh about 5 minutes before expires_in runs out
on token_expired refresh once and retry the call once

subject: invalid_token right after we rotated our API key
body: This morning an admin rotated our production API key in the dashboard. Since then all calls fail with 401 and error.code invalid_token, even though we still use tokens we got an hour ago. Did the rotation break something?
allowed_facts: rotating the API key revokes all tokens issued with the old key
calls then fail with invalid_token
obtain new tokens with the new key

subject: 401 on production with a brand new token
body: We just went live and every call to https://api.fernwick.example returns 401 invalid_token. The token starts with fw_test_ and worked fine in our tests last week. Request ID req_A81kQ.
allowed_facts: sandbox tokens (fw_test_) never work against api.fernwick.example
production needs a fw_live_ token

subject: 403 when starting an export
body: POST /v1/exports returns 403 Forbidden. The body has error.code insufficient_scope and error.required_scope exports:run. Other endpoints work with the same key.
allowed_facts: 403 means authenticated but not allowed
the key lacks the exports:run scope
a workspace admin can add the scope in Dashboard > Developers > API keys

subject: Teammate cannot create an API key with write scopes
body: Our developer Sam can create API keys but the invoices:write scope is greyed out for him. He has the Developer role in our workspace. How do we let him create the key we need?
allowed_facts: Developer role can create keys with read scopes only
an Admin can create keys with write scopes
role changes are made by a workspace admin in Dashboard > Settings > Members
support cannot change roles

subject: Everything returns 403 account_suspended
body: Since this morning every request returns 403 with error.code account_suspended. We have not received any email. Why was our workspace suspended and how do we fix it today?

subject: Our sync keeps getting 429
body: During our hourly sync we get 429 Too Many Requests on GET /v1/invoices. Our HTTP client retries the request immediately when that happens, but the 429s keep going for minutes. What are we doing wrong?
allowed_facts: wait the number of seconds in Retry-After
retrying immediately keeps the workspace over the limit
X-RateLimit-Remaining headers help slow down before 429

subject: No Retry-After header on 429 responses
body: We get 429 responses but our code cannot find a Retry-After header, so it does not know how long to wait. Our traffic goes through a corporate proxy. What should our client do?
allowed_facts: 429 always includes Retry-After
a proxy may remove it
without it use exponential backoff from 1 second doubling to 60 seconds with jitter

subject: Need a higher rate limit for Black Friday
body: We are on the Standard plan and expect around 400 requests per second during Black Friday for invoice creation. Can you raise our limit to 500 per second from next Monday?

subject: Webhooks never reach our new endpoint
body: We moved our webhook receiver to a new URL. The endpoint in the dashboard still points to http://hooks.acme-books.example/fernwick, which now answers with 301 Moved Permanently to the https URL. Since then we receive no events. Example event evt_77Xa1.
allowed_facts: redirects are not followed
delivery needs a 2xx within 10 seconds
update the endpoint URL to the final https URL
delivery attempts are in the delivery log

subject: Webhook signature verification always fails
body: Our Express app parses the JSON body with body-parser and then computes the HMAC over JSON.stringify(req.body) to compare with the Fernwick-Signature header. It never matches. Example event evt_0Lm2P.
allowed_facts: verification must use the raw request body bytes
signed payload is timestamp.raw body
recommended tolerance is 5 minutes

subject: We receive the same webhook event twice
body: Sometimes our endpoint gets the same invoice.paid event two or three times, and once we got invoice.updated before invoice.created. Is this a bug on your side?
allowed_facts: events may arrive more than once and out of order
deduplicate by event ID
use updated_at to decide which state is newer

subject: Some webhooks are missing
body: Hi, I think we are missing some webhooks. Not all of them, just some. Can you look into it?

subject: Export is taking longer than usual
body: Our monthly export job_7QpL2 was created 40 minutes ago. It is in status processing and progress_percent went from 20 to 55 since then. It usually finishes faster. Is something wrong?
allowed_facts: jobs under 2 hours with increasing progress are within normal time
large exports can take up to 2 hours
poll no more often than every 30 seconds
no completion time promised

subject: Batch import stuck in queued since morning
body: Batch job_4HrR9 was created at 04:30 UTC and is still in status queued with progress_percent 0. It is 10:00 UTC now. We need these invoices today.

subject: Your API is broken for us
body: Nothing works since the last deploy on your side. Please fix ASAP, this is blocking our customers.

subject: Request to delete all data about a former customer
body: Under GDPR one of our former customers asked us to delete their data. Please permanently delete every invoice and customer record about customer cus_91Ae from your systems and confirm in writing.
